registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Global control register for the demo SRAM controller.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable for controller-visible operation. When 0, controller behavior is held inactive for software-visible access sequencing.

fields.name: SOFT_RESET
fields.description: Software-requested reset of controller-visible state. Self-clearing or level-sensitive handling is implementation-defined, but it must clear control/status-visible state without changing the top-level port list.

fields.name: IRQ_ENABLE
fields.description: Enables irq assertion when latched BIST done/fail status is present.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

fields.name: READY
fields.description: Indicates controller ready for a new software-visible memory or BIST request.

fields.name: BIST_DONE
fields.description: Latched BIST completion indication.

fields.name: BIST_FAIL
fields.description: Latched BIST failure indication.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Indicates controller is busy with a memory access or BIST bookkeeping action.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

fields.name: ADDR
fields.description: Memory address for subsequent read or write access. Matches the 256-word scratchpad depth.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

fields.name: WDATA
fields.description: 32-bit write data staged for a memory write transaction.

fields.name: RDATA
fields.description: 32-bit read data captured from the scratchpad memory.

fields.name: MEM_WRITE
fields.description: Write strobe/command bit. When asserted, commits MEM_WDATA to MEM_ADDR through the SRAM wrapper.

fields.name: MEM_READ
fields.description: Read strobe/command bit. When asserted, captures the addressed memory word into MEM_RDATA and drives rd_data.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

registers.name: BIST_CONTROL
registers.description: BIST request and result-clear control register.

fields.name: START
fields.description: Software-requested BIST start pulse or level. Also accepts the external bist_start input as a request qualifier.

fields.name: CLEAR_RESULT
fields.description: Clears latched BIST done/fail state and associated sticky interrupt indications.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

fields.name: DONE
fields.description: Latched indication that a BIST operation completed.

fields.name: FAIL
fields.description: Latched indication that a BIST operation failed.

fields.name: RUNNING
fields.description: Indicates a BIST operation is in progress.

fields.name: LAST_FAIL_ADDR
fields.description: Address of the last observed BIST failure, if any.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.description: Interrupt status register with sticky latched sources.

fields.name: BIST_DONE
fields.description: Sticky interrupt source indicating BIST completion.

fields.name: BIST_FAIL
fields.description: Sticky interrupt source indicating BIST failure.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

registers.name: IRQ_CLEAR
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear register for IRQ_STATUS sticky bits.

fields.name: BIST_DONE_CLR
fields.description: Writing 1 clears IRQ_STATUS.BIST_DONE.

fields.name: BIST_FAIL_CLR
fields.description: Writing 1 clears IRQ_STATUS.BIST_FAIL.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved; write 0.

sources.name: BIST_DONE_IRQ
sources.description: Asserted when BIST completes and the corresponding latched interrupt source is set while IRQ_ENABLE is enabled.

sources.name: BIST_FAIL_IRQ
sources.description: Asserted when BIST fails and the corresponding latched interrupt source is set while IRQ_ENABLE is enabled.

init_sequence: Assert reset_n low then high; verify STATUS.READY=0, BIST status cleared, IRQ_STATUS cleared, and MEM_RDATA cleared after reset release.
Program MEM_ADDR and MEM_WDATA before issuing a memory write via MEM_CONTROL.MEM_WRITE=1; deassert or allow self-clear according to implementation after the access is accepted.
Program MEM_ADDR before issuing a memory read via MEM_CONTROL.MEM_READ=1; poll STATUS.READY or read back MEM_RDATA after the access completes.
If BIST is desired, write BIST_CONTROL.START=1 or pulse bist_start; then monitor BIST_STATUS until DONE or FAIL is observed.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS.BUSY until 0 before starting a new access.
Poll BIST_STATUS.RUNNING until 0, then inspect BIST_STATUS.DONE and BIST_STATUS.FAIL.
Read MEM_RDATA after a MEM_READ transaction to obtain the accessed scratchpad word.
Read IRQ_STATUS to determine which sticky interrupt source is pending.
irq_sequence: Start BIST using BIST_CONTROL.START or bist_start.
Read BIST_STATUS and IRQ_STATUS to determine whether the event was a done or fail condition.
Clear sticky interrupt sources by writing 1s to IRQ_CLEAR bits and, if needed, clear result state with BIST_CONTROL.CLEAR_RESULT.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The top module remains a controller and is not replaced by a raw SRAM model.
No new hierarchy or external ports are introduced.
The register map is software-visible and compatible with the specified controller port list and memory wrapper intent.
The selected bus type is a minimal custom memory-mapped register interface, consistent with the specification and not forced to AXI/APB.
